scenario.brief: We are setting the quarter plan and the budget together for once. I want each lead to say what they are committing to and what it actually costs, so we stop agreeing plans that the budget was never going to cover.
scenario.theDecision: The plan totals 141% of the available budget because two leads have both budgeted the same contractor. Neither knows. A right answer catches the double-count from the two accounts rather than trimming both plans by a fifth.
